name: aitp-control-plane
//overrides: Transitive security floors for `npx audit-ci --config ./audit-ci.jsonc` (the CI gate: prod deps, high+). next 15.5.x hard-pins postcss 8.4.31 and ships sharp ^0.34.3; both now carry high-severity advisories, and neither can be cleared by a next patch bump. The floors chosen are exactly what next 16.3.x ships natively (postcss 8.5.23, sharp ^0.35.3), so this backports a combination upstream already runs rather than inventing one. brace-expansion is a SEPARATE chain (@opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node -> resource-detector-gcp -> gcp-metadata -> gaxios -> rimraf -> glob -> minimatch@9) and is deliberately SCOPED, not global: this tree legitimately resolves three majors of brace-expansion -- minimatch@10 (top level, used by eslint) needs ^5.0.5, minimatch@9 needs ^2.0.2, minimatch@3 needs ^1.1.7 -- and a global pin to 2.x breaks eslint, because only 5.x exports a named `expand`. Remove postcss/sharp when this repo moves to next >= 16.3.0; remove the OTel entry when that dependency stops resolving a vulnerable brace-expansion. Tracked in issue #47.
